title: Building Fire on Toltecas Street Injures Two
detail: A fire on July 6, 2026, at a building on Calle Toltecas No. 70, near Granada Street in Mexico City, left two people with burn injuries and completely charred two vehicles. Reports indicate the fire started when a mechanic repairing a taxi handled gasoline near a storage area containing clothing and chairs, causing the flames to spread rapidly through the structure.

media.caption: Fire on Toltecas Street leaves two injured in Mexico City
